reviews.rationale: Sequential (FY2025 Q4 to FY2026 Q1) comparison of selected SEC rows, not year over year. GAAP operating income rose +14750 USD_thousand to 192071 on revenues +10720 to 607621 and total operating expenses -4030 to 415550 (cost of services -754, SG&A -3276); these are exact signed identities, not causal explanations. The operating gain was more than offset below the line: total other income signed swung -13588 to -1958, driven mainly by other income signed -12128 (22466 to 10338) plus interest income -961 and interest expense signed -499; pretax income therefore rose only +1162 to 190113, and a higher tax expense +2198 to 37533 left GAAP net income -1036 lower at 152580. GAAP diluted EPS still rose +0.03 to 4.06 because diluted shares fell -543 thousand to 37615. Non-GAAP adjusted operating income rose +18393 to 220094 and adjusted operating margin +2.4 percentage points to 36.2 percent, while adjusted net income +14981 to 169571 and adjusted diluted EPS +0.46 to 4.51; organic revenues +12703 to 600029. The GAAP/non-GAAP divergence (GAAP net income down, adjusted net income up) is material counterevidence to a simple margin-expansion read and is not reconciled in the extract. Missing evidence: the composition of the other-income swing, the GAAP-to-adjusted reconciliation items, segment/organic growth detail, any guidance versus realized results, and year-over-year comparatives. Because the alert carries no trusted statement_line metadata and the driver of the other-income swing is unresolved, the review is recorded as needs_review, which preserves status and conviction and blocks downstream decisions. No valuation or trading conclusion is drawn.

message.content:
# FDS Research-State Evaluation — FY2025 Q4 → FY2026 Q1 (sequential, selected SEC rows)

**Scope note:** All comparisons below are **sequential** (FY2025 Q4 ended 2025-08-31 → FY2026 Q1 ended 2025-11-30), **not year over year**. Figures are selected SEC rows from two earnings releases, not complete filings. Signed accounting identities are arithmetic, not economic causes. No valuation, recommendation, or trade is made.

## 1. Conclusion

The quarter presents a **mixed, internally divergent** picture rather than a clean margin-expansion story. Operating-level GAAP results improved, but GAAP net income declined because a below-the-line swing more than offset the operating gain. Simultaneously, non-GAAP adjusted results improved materially. The two bases moved in **opposite directions on net income**, and the extract does not reconcile them. Research state: **needs_review**, thesis **blocked**.

## 2. Supported implication

- **GAAP operating income rose +14,750 USD_thousand to 192,071**, on revenues **+10,720 to 607,621** and total operating expenses **−4,030 to 415,550** (cost of services −754; SG&A −3,276). This is an exact signed identity [BRIDGE-OPERATING-INCOME, BRIDGE-OPEX], not an attribution of why revenue rose or expenses fell.
- **The operating gain did not reach the bottom line.** Total other income signed swung **−13,588 to −1,958**, composed of other income signed −12,128 (22,466 → 10,338), interest income −961, and interest expense signed −499 [BRIDGE-OTHER-INCOME]. Pretax income therefore rose only **+1,162 to 190,113** [BRIDGE-PRETAX], and tax expense **+2,198 to 37,533** left GAAP net income **−1,036 lower at 152,580** [BRIDGE-NET-INCOME].
- **GAAP diluted EPS nonetheless rose +0.03 to 4.06** while GAAP net income fell, because diluted shares fell **−543 thousand to 37,615**. EPS direction and net income direction differ here; the share-count change is the reconciling item, not evidence of improved per-share economics.
- **Non-GAAP basis improved:** adjusted operating income **+18,393 to 220,094**; adjusted operating margin **+2.4 percentage points to 36.2 percent** (percentage points, not percent); adjusted net income **+14,981 to 169,571**; adjusted diluted EPS **+0.46 to 4.51**; organic revenues **+12,703 to 600,029**.

## 3. Material counterevidence

- **GAAP vs non-GAAP divergence on net income.** GAAP net income fell −1,036 while adjusted net income rose +14,981. A margin-improvement reading is only supported on the adjusted basis; on the GAAP basis, net income declined. The extract does not show the GAAP-to-adjusted reconciliation, so the size and nature of the excluded items are unknown.
- **The other-income swing dominates the GAAP result.** The −13,588 swing in total other income is larger in magnitude than the +14,750 operating gain. Whether this reflects recurring or non-recurring items is not determinable from the extract.
- **Organic vs reported revenue differ in direction of magnitude.** Organic revenues rose +12,703 while reported GAAP revenues rose +10,720 — organic growth exceeded reported growth in this extract, which would ordinarily imply a currency/acquisition drag, but the extract contains no such bridge and I do not assert that cause.

## 4. Missing evidence

- Composition and nature (recurring vs non-recurring) of the **other income signed** swing of −12,128.
- The **GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation** items and their period-over-period change.
- Segment detail, organic growth bridge, and any **guidance versus realized results** — the extract contains no guidance figures, so no guidance comparison is made.
- **Year-over-year comparatives** — none are in scope here; sequential changes cannot be read as annual trends.
- Tax rate drivers behind the +2,198 tax expense change.
- Note: absence of an item from this extract is **not** evidence of its absence from the full filings.

## 5. Research-state decision and actions taken

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Thesis match | `th_d53fbbbed4b64680aca7` matched on symbol only (match_score 0, `model_review_required`) |
| Review persisted | `tr_5097f46c4b274a75b235`, decision **needs_review**, impact **mixed**, thesis version 1 → **2** |
| Alert | `fa_c87d61b9bdf0428293cf` → **acknowledged** (version 2) |
| Block verification | `decision_hold: true`, `actionability: blocked`, `decision_hold_alert_id: fa_c87d61b9bdf0428293cf`; status **active** and conviction **3** preserved |

**Block confirmed:** the needs_review decision left the thesis held and non-actionable, with status and conviction unchanged. Resolution requires a sourced, complete, conflict-free alert for the same event period with source continuity, plus new source evidence addressing the other-income composition and the GAAP-to-adjusted reconciliation.

**Process note:** my first review attempt was rejected (`accounting_lineage_metadata_missing`) because the stored alert carries no trusted statement-line metadata; I therefore recorded no structured causal claims and left attribution unresolved in the rationale rather than asserting a driver.
